{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Calculate conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_conversion_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()

conversion_rates, highest_conversion_segment"}
